messages:
incident-bot: Paging @sre-team: Detecting abrupt spike in 5xx error rate from edge → gateway for prod-west. Severity: P1. Aggregated error rate 5xx = 18% over last 5m, latency 95p increased. Auto-page to oncall. Logs: https://logs.redwood/example/trace/1798765439

amanda: ack — I'm on it, looking at dashboards now. Can someone drop the most recent deploys?

raj: saw a small route weight rollout ~10m ago that shifted traffic to cluster svc-model-v2. It was a gradual 10 -> 40% change via the LB service. Noticed retries configured on the gateway for that route.

oliver: confirming: envoy config shows per-route retries=3 and per-cluster circuit_breakers max_connections=100. svc-model-v2 pods are flapping 502s according to k8s events.

amanda: pulling envoy config dump: `curl -s http://localhost:9901/config_dump | jq '.configs[] | select(.@type=="type.googleapis.com/envoy.config.route.v3.RouteConfiguration")'`

oliver: paste of relevant bits: ```json
{"route": "svc-model", "retry_policy": {"num_retries": 3, "per_try_timeout": "1s"}, "weighted_clusters": [{"name":"svc-model-v1","weight":60},{"name":"svc-model-v2","weight":40}]}
```

raj: svc-model-v2 recently had a change that increased workspace init CPU; fewer ready replicas during the shift. Circuit breaker not tripped quickly so envoy keeps retrying and amplifying error tail.

amanda: customer impact: API token-scoped routes show increased 5xxs for high-traffic customers in us-west-2. Support ticket stream spiking. Estimated affected requests ~12k/min.

eng-oncall: I'm going to disable retries at the gateway for this route as an immediate mitigation (to avoid retry amplification). Will also reduce weight for v2 to 10%.

sre-lead: approved. Go for it. Post changes we should monitor for downstream error percentage and latency.

eng-oncall: running command: ```
# set retries to 0 for svc-model route and adjust weights
kubectl exec -it gateway-xyz -- envoyctl set-route svc-model --retries=0
kubectl exec -it gateway-xyz -- envoyctl set-route svc-model --weights=svc-model-v1:90,svc-model-v2:10
```

oliver: patch applied on gateway primary, propagating to 3 proxies.

amanda: watching graphs — 5xx dropped from 18% → 6% over 2m. Latency 95p improving.

prod-support: Support notes — telling impacted customers we see transient failures and that we're mitigating; CS is triaging high-severity tickets.

raj: while retries likely amplified, why were v2 pods flapping 502? K8s events show Liveness probe timeouts around the same time of the rollout. There was a config bump to `startup_timeout_ms` on the model container.

oliver: logs from svc-model-v2 pod-7: `ERROR: failed to init workspace: timed out after 30s` then quick restart. Pod CPU pegged during init causing probe failures.

amanda: mitigation path: rollback the startup change on v2 and scale replica count up to absorb traffic, then reintroduce traffic gradually with weight 10 -> 20 -> 40 with health checks.

eng-oncall: opened PR to revert startup change and issued a `kubectl rollout undo deployment/svc-model-v2` to the previous working revision. Also bumped replicas from 3 -> 6 temporarily.

sre-lead: good. Also add short-term outlier detection to eject unhealthy hosts quicker: `outlier_detection: consecutive_5xx: 5` -> set to 3 for quicker eject. Will coordinate with infra.

amanda: monitoring: 5xx now at 2.2% and trending down. Error spike for top 5 customers reduced to trace-level.

prod-support: customers updated. One enterprise customer had brief SLA hit but no data loss. Logging ticket #CS-4422 created.

raj: after rollback and ejection tweak, v2 pod restarts stopped. I'll watch the pod readiness and resource usage.

oliver: any follow-up to avoid this in the future? Suggest a pre-rollout canary for route weight >20%, and add an invariant check that prevents retries being enabled during weight-shifts.

amanda: agreed. Action items: (1) create canary gating for LB weight changes, (2) add rollout-runbook step to scale target before increasing weight, (3) alert rule for retry amplification detection (high error rate + retries>0).

sre-lead: assigning owners: raj -> rollback postmortem section; oliver -> alert rule; amanda -> runbook update; eng-oncall -> follow up with infra on outlier defaults. Please document timeframe for RCA.

eng-oncall: handover: I'll leave this in monitoring-attenuate state and hand to night oncall in 30m. Summary: route weight shift to svc-model-v2 + retries caused retry amplification; v2 had startup config change causing probe failures; mitigation: disable retries, reduce weight, rollback v2 config, increase replicas, tune outlier detection.

incident-bot: Incident resolved (mitigated) — 5xx rate returned to baseline. Please file a postmortem and mark as P1 -> P1-resolved when complete.

amanda: thanks everyone. I'll start drafting the postmortem and include timelines and customer impact estimates. :thumbsup:

raj: +1. Will attach kube events and deploy diffs.

oliver: leaving notes on envoy config diffs and the temporary outlier setting we used.

prod-support: CS will follow up with impacted customers tomorrow morning with more details.

eng-oncall: last check: all services green, moving thread to monitoring. Handing off to night oncall @sre_night.

sre-lead: excellent runbooked steps. Postmortem deadline EOD tomorrow.

amanda: closing thread once postmortem is published. Thanks all.
